evaluated_on: primary comparison only (M2 vs M0, L2 logistic, selected configuration)

conditions_for_support.S2: Delta > 0 in at least 5 of the 8 development folds (a strict majority)
conditions_for_support.S3: two-way cluster (pigeonhole) bootstrap 95% percentile CI for the development pooled-OOF Delta has lower bound > 0
conditions_for_support.S4: holdout Delta PR-AUC > 0 (directional confirmation; its CI is reported, not required)
conditions_for_support.S5: no severe calibration deterioration on the holdout: Brier(M2) <= 1.05 * Brier(M0) AND |slope(M2) - 1| <= |slope(M0) - 1| + 0.20
conditions_for_support.S6: every check of H20_2_PIT_AUDIT_PLAN.md passes (0 violations)
conditions_for_support.S7: not driven by one era: Delta > 0 in at least 2 of the 3 era blocks {2022 folds, 2023 folds, 2025 holdout} AND the development pooled-OOF Delta stays > 0 when each fold is left out in turn

rules_in_order: DATA / DESIGN FAILURE if: S6 fails; or the sealed target checks fail (unparsable announcement time, an event matching > 1 era); or any development fold has < 5 unique positive events or the holdout has < 20; or > 20% of landmark weeks lack every context source; or a model fails to converge twice; or the holdout has to be opened more than once
INCREMENTAL CONTEXT SIGNAL SUPPORTED if S1-S7 all hold
NEGATIVE INCREMENTAL RESULT if the development bootstrap CI upper bound < 0 AND holdout Delta < 0
PRE-REGISTERED NULL otherwise (including any CI straddling zero, any fold-majority failure, any holdout veto)

annotations_not_verdicts.materiality: MATERIAL if absolute Delta >= 0.01 AND relative Delta >= 10% on both development and holdout, else SMALL (reported with any verdict; never converts one verdict into another)
annotations_not_verdicts.classifier_free_robustness: M2_core vs M0 evaluated identically; if the primary verdict is SUPPORTED and M2_core fails S1 or S4, annotate 'support depends on agent-audited classifiers'
annotations_not_verdicts.model_class_robustness: LightGBM M2 vs M0 evaluated identically; disagreement with the primary is annotated, never substituted
annotations_not_verdicts.context_only: M1 / M1_core reported for completeness; a context-only model ranks weeks, not assets

never: no new verdict label after execution
no switch of primary metric, model class, arm or split
no claim of trading profitability (H20.4 territory)

inference.primary: pigeonhole two-way cluster bootstrap (Owen 2007): each replicate resamples asset-eras with replacement and, independently, calendar blocks with replacement; a row's weight = (multiplicity of its asset-era) x (multiplicity of its block); weighted PR-AUC of M2 and M0 recomputed on the same weights; Delta per replicate

blocks.development: the 8 fold test windows (13 weeks each)

inference.models_not_refit: replicates reweight fixed out-of-fold predictions; models are not refit inside the bootstrap
